prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, apex siren physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; everything about her is at its extreme at once: a towering frame with endless legs, a colossal heavy bust wider than her shoulders, a waist cinched to an impossible minimum, enormous round hips and a high rounded rear, gigantic thick thighs pressed together, smooth glowing skin over soft full curves; her silhouette is an exaggerated hourglass that dominates the whole frame from head to toe; her head looks small above her body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, sleek slicked-back teal hair — wearing nothing but a liquid silver chrome micro bikini: a tiny molded top with a centre zip pulled halfway down and an ultra micro bikini bottom tied with thin side strings, the mirror-bright metal catching every reflection around her, every other part of her body, her shoulders, arms, stomach, thighs, legs, face and hands, plain bare real skin. Real photographic skin across her whole body, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The outfit reflects the surrounding mirrors in soft highlights, her skin tone running naturally everywhere else. Pose: standing facing the camera straight on, her left hand resting on her hip and her right arm relaxed at her side, her legs fully in view — most extreme apex siren silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy pale blue leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each longer than her middle finger, in pale blue lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip.

Background: a mirrored cube room with mirrors on all four walls, the ceiling and a glossy black floor, thin hot-pink neon LED strips running along every corner so the pink lines multiply into an endless glowing lattice in all directions, her figure repeated in the lattice from every side, the whole floor clearly visible and in focus, lit by the pink neon and soft light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, the reflections being part of that same photograph, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
